files.library.verbalization.txt:
=== Header ===
Derived mechanically from the ORM model by `gnd extract` (R-08").
Constraint-blind by specification: object types, reference schemes,
fact-type readings and primitive shapes only — no constraint
sentences, no modality, no provenance. Hand-authoring this file is
banned; regenerate it with `gnd extract MODEL --out DIR`.

=== Object Types ===
Borrower is identified by CardNumber.
CardNumber is a value of type String.
BorrowerName is a value of type String.
Title is identified by Isbn.
Isbn is a value of type String.
Genre is a value of type String.
PublicationYear is a value of type Integer.
Copy is identified by the combination of work (in fact type copy_is_of_title) and mark (in fact type copy_has_shelf_mark).
ShelfMark is a value of type String.
Branch is identified by BranchCode.
BranchCode is a value of type String.
Librarian is identified by StaffNumber.
StaffNumber is a value of type Integer.
LoanPeriod is identified by a value in day (Duration).
CalendarDay is a value of type Date.
FineAmount is a value of type Number.
CirculatingCopy is a kind of Copy, inheriting the reference of Copy.
ReferenceCopy is a kind of Copy, inheriting the reference of Copy.

=== Fact Types ===
Borrower has BorrowerName
  - member: Borrower (String)
  - full_name: BorrowerName (String)

Borrower holds CardNumber
  - member: Borrower (String)
  - card: CardNumber (String)

Borrower is registered at Branch
  - member: Borrower (String)
  - home_branch: Branch (String)

Title has Isbn
  - work: Title (String)
  - code: Isbn (String)

Title was published in PublicationYear
  - work: Title (String)
  - year: PublicationYear (Integer)

Title is shelved under Genre
  - work: Title (String)
  - category: Genre (String)

Copy is a copy of Title
  - item: Copy
  - work: Title (String)

Copy carries ShelfMark
  - volume: Copy
  - mark: ShelfMark (String)

Copy is held at Branch
  - item: Copy
  - holding_branch: Branch (String)

Copy was lent to Borrower on CalendarDay until CalendarDay
  - item: Copy
  - member: Borrower (String)
  - lent_on: CalendarDay (Date)
  - due_on: CalendarDay (Date)

Title is reserved by Borrower
  - work: Title (String)
  - member: Borrower (String)

Borrower owes FineAmount
  - member: Borrower (String)
  - owed: FineAmount (Number)

Title is lent for LoanPeriod
  - work: Title (String)
  - term: LoanPeriod

Librarian manages Branch
  - staff: Librarian (Integer)
  - managed_branch: Branch (String)

Copy is on loan
  - subject: Copy

Copy is withdrawn
  - subject: Copy

Copy is shelved
  - subject: Copy

Borrower shares a household with Borrower
  - member: Borrower (String)
  - housemate: Borrower (String)

Title supersedes Title
  - successor: Title (String)
  - predecessor: Title (String)
